story_text: As a user, I want task creation to fail when the title is empty so that all tasks have a meaningful name.

positive.title: Create task with empty string title
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the task creation endpoint with an empty string as the title.
2. Observe the response from the server.
positive.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states title is required

negative.title: Create task with whitespace-only title
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the task creation endpoint with a whitespace-only string as the title.
2. Observe the response from the server.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states title is required

negative.title: Create task with null title
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the task creation endpoint with a null value for the title.
2. Observe the response from the server.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states title is required

negative.title: Create task with missing title field
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the task creation endpoint without the title field.
2. Observe the response from the server.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states title is required

edge.title: Create task with title as a non-string type (e.g., number or boolean)
steps: 1. Send a POST request to the task creation endpoint with a non-string value for the title.
2. Observe the response from the server.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states title must be a string
